title: X10: All-day scheduler default hardcoded 09:00, never hydrated from prefs; reconcile rewrites correct triggers back

description: The all-day scheduler default is hardcoded 09:00 at construction, never hydrated from user preferences at launch - and worse, the reconcile pass actively REWRITES correct pending triggers back to 09:00. Compounding: per-device timeZone defeats cross-device all-day dedup, so both devices fire. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 4, plan 4b notification-truthfulness. Sweep: cross-process.
